_comment: Feature 2, redesigned (friction-log A10): the RWA API's advertised sector filter (Magnificent 7 / AI Chips / ETF / Buffett Portfolio) doesn't exist server-side - 13+ real signed calls with plausible sectorTab values all returned the same unfiltered 488 tokens. This is a small, self-maintained, versioned replacement: real bStock tickers and BSC contract addresses, read from Binance's public RWA token list on 2026-09-25 and cross-checked against docs/research/verified-facts.md (NVDAB's address matches exactly). Every address here is pinned by exact address, never resolved by ticker at commit time - same rule as configureToken's own doc comment.
